lines.text: David stayed in Jerusalem while Joab besieged Rabbah, and David sent for Bathsheba after seeing her bathing.
Bathsheba sent word that she was pregnant, so David summoned Uriah and told him to go down to his house.
Uriah slept at the palace door with the servants, and even drunk, he did not go to his house.
David wrote a letter to Abner telling him to put Uriah at the front of the fiercest battle, and Uriah died.
After Bathsheba mourned, David brought her to his house, and she bore him a daughter.
